# DFKI MiR100 Source Record

- Upstream: https://github.com/DFKI-NI/mir_robot
- Package: `mir_description`
- Upstream commit: `7d9c72942d512b191f2b326ca89c066710db4e34`
- Branch at import: `humble`
- Imported on: 2026-07-16
- License: BSD-3-Clause, retained as `LICENSE`
- Files retained: MiR100 body, driven wheel, caster base and SICK safety-scanner visual meshes; the relevant Xacro geometry/transform definitions; package metadata
- Purpose: realistic mobile-robot geometry, wheel dimensions and sensor placement for the Felix Zuo V8 cinematic

The source geometry is used without manufacturer branding or endorsement claims. Project-owned payload fixtures, fleet markings and materials are layered on top. Public deployment receives rendered media rather than redistributable standalone source assets.
